about: One-line descriptions of EXISTING public functions of the shared tools files that have no docstring (card chat-T8, user 2026-10-09). Key '<module>.<function>' (module = file name without .py; a method is 'Class.method'). Writing a docstring into an existing function would shift every file:line citation below it, so its description lives here; a NEW function carries a docstring instead (docs/script-writing.md rule 9). tools/gen_capabilities.py shows a docstring first, else this entry, else '(undocumented)'; a key whose function is gone is a WARN in doc_lint L12. Each entry says what the function does and what it returns, verified by reading its code.

items.stage_prerun.sha256: SHA-256 hex digest of a file; a .py/.ps1 is hashed WITHOUT its scope header block (scope_header.canonical_bytes) so records written before the header migration still match. Returns the hex string.
items.stagesim.parse_addr: Terminal address -> {'uid': head, 'term': terminal}: a dict is copied, a '<uid>.<terminal>' / 'new:<kind><n>.<terminal>' string is split at its first '.'; anything else raises SimError.
items.stagexec.edges: Groups terminal rows by wire_uid; returns (E, dang): E = set of (source term_uid, sink term_uid) pairs of every wire, dang = term_uids on a wire that has no source or no sink.
items.addrcheck.jev_switched_on: True when the Jev address advisory is on: env ADDR_JEV is not '0' and the JSON at path (default MEASURE) has a truthy 'switched_on'; an absent or unreadable file gives False. Returns bool.
items.allterms.main: CLI: reads every terminal of the VI (read_terms with --op, default OP_ALLTERMS) and every wire uid, joins them into a wire table, flags severed wires; writes <stem>.json (meta + terminals) and <stem>_wires.json, prints the meta. Returns 0.
items.audit_cycle.say: Appends {check, ok, detail} to the module RESULT list and prints a PASS / FAIL / n-a line (ok True / False / other). Returns None.
items.audit_cycle.read: Text of file p (utf-8, errors replaced); '' when it cannot be opened. Returns str.
items.audit_cycle.main: CLI cycle audit over a window (--from/--to, else --since-hours; --cycle labels it): the A/C checks on bench build logs and archived reviews plus doc_lint, each via say(); prints AUDIT PASS or VIOLATIONS (JSON summary with --json). Returns 1 if any check failed, else 0.
items.bgrun.main: CLI runner: runs the command after -- with output appended to --log between BGRUN START/PID and END/TIMEOUT lines, reaps dead runners' logs, records stage runs, tree-kills at --max-min; --detach relaunches detached. Returns child rc, 1 if rc 0 but a RESULT line failed, 124 on timeout.
items.bgrun_reap.killed_line: The newline-terminated 'BGRUN KILLED (external) pid=<pid> marked <now> by <who>: ...' line that reap() appends to a dead runner's log. Returns str.
items.bgrun_reap.main: CLI over reap(): marks (with --dry-run only lists) dead-runner logs under --bench, excluding $BGRUN_LOG; prints MARKED / LIVE / NO-PID lines, a scanned/marked summary and a RESULT line. Returns 0.
items.card_clock.find_bind: First 'BOUND agent ... (id <cid>)' line of the guard_card log: returns (datetime of its stamp, 1-based line number), or (None, None) when the log or the line is absent.
items.card_clock.clock: Measures a result file's minutes (its mtime minus the card's first bind line) against the task card's budget.minutes and the claimed cost.minutes. Returns (CLOCK line, verdict OK / CLOCK-MISMATCH / CLOCK-UNMEASURED, rc 0 / 1 / 2).
items.card_clock.main: CLI: clock() on one result_<id>.json (--log, --cards); prints the CLOCK line and a RESULT line (SKIP when unmeasured, FAIL on a mismatch). Returns clock's rc 0 / 1 / 2.
items.census_predict.md5_of: MD5 hex digest of the file at p (read whole, binary). Returns str.
items.census_predict.predict: Resolves each plan action to a sampled class-count delta, sums them, and compares per class with the prediction file's census block. Returns {rows, classes (derived/declared/verdict), derived, declared, unpredicted row numbers, overall PASS/FAIL/UNPREDICTED/UNDECLARED}.
items.census_predict.result_line: The 'RESULT {...}' result-line/1 string of a predict() report: FAIL on a failing class, SKIP for UNPREDICTED / UNDECLARED, else PASS, with per-class pass/fail counts and the given artefacts. Returns str.
items.census_predict.main: CLI: 'record <op> <variant> --delta .. --cites ..' stores a measured sample (record_sample); otherwise '<plan.json> <pred.json> [--samples] [--json]' prints ROW / CLASS / VERDICT lines and a RESULT line. Returns 0 PASS or recorded, 1 FAIL, 2 UNPREDICTED, 3 UNDECLARED, 4 error.
items.cycle_runner.spawn_env: Copy of os.environ for a spawned session: drops the inherited role variables (CYCLE_ROLE, ASSIGN_STATE, ASSIGN_RESULT, PURPOSE_PHASE, HANDBACK_RECORD), adds SPAWN_ENV_EXTRA, then `extra`. Returns dict.
items.cycle_runner.read: Text of file p (utf-8, errors replaced); '' when it cannot be opened. Returns str.
items.cycle_runner.next_section: Body of the '## NEXT' section of STATUS text (up to the next '## ' heading), stripped; '' when there is none. Returns str.
items.cycle_runner.next_last_line: Last non-blank line of the NEXT section, cut to 160 chars; '(no NEXT section)' when the section is empty or absent. Returns str.
items.cycle_runner.log_line: Appends text plus a newline to the log at path (creating its folder; an OSError is ignored) and prints the text. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.last_cycle_number: Highest N among the 'CYCLE N |' lines of the runner log; 0 when there are none. Returns int.
items.cycle_runner.goalmap_done: Set of milestone ids whose status is 'done' in the goal-map JSON at path; empty set when the file is absent or unreadable. Returns set.
items.cycle_runner.judge_state_load: Reads <bench>/judge_ladder.json. Returns (level clamped to 0..JUDGE_TOP, reason); (0, 'start') when the file is absent or malformed.
items.cycle_runner.judge_state_save: Writes {level, reason (300 chars), after_cycle n, at now} to <bench>/judge_ladder.json; any failure is swallowed. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat: Runner heartbeat state (current cycle, phase, cycles done, summed cost); emit() writes the HEARTBEAT line to the runner log, rewrites heartbeat_latest.md and raises a toast.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.begin: Marks cycle n as running and stamps its start time. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.cycle_end: Counts one finished cycle, adds its cost (a '$x' string; an unparseable one is ignored), sets the phase to 'ended HH:MM (exit rc, cost)' and emits a cycle-end heartbeat. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.emit: Writes one 'HEARTBEAT | ...' line (cycle, last result card, hook states, open decisions, deliverables, next act) to the runner log, rewrites heartbeat_latest.md, raises a toast; an error becomes a HEARTBEAT-ERROR line. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.final: Emits the 'final' heartbeat once; later calls do nothing. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.newest_assign_result: Path of the most recently modified assign_result_*.json in cards_dir, or None when there is none.
items.cycle_runner.purpose_from_next: The assignment card's purpose dict from a next.json card: act and pass items (each cut to 200 chars), plan {path, md5} or None, advances, unblocks, task_kind, note. Returns dict.
items.cycle_runner.write_assign_card: Builds and validates an assign/1 card (cycle, round, purpose, next_md5, caps from cfg, state / result / handback paths, ASSIGN_AGENTS) and writes cards_dir/assign_<n>_<k>.json. Returns (path, None), or (None, why) when it does not validate.
items.cycle_runner.write_handback: Writes cards_dir/handback_<n>_<k>.json (handback/1: trigger, detail, the assignment state's card rows, result path, next_md5, cost, minutes); a record that fails validation is replaced by a minimal one carrying the reason. Returns the path.
items.cycle_runner.main: CLI entry of the cycle runner: parses the run options (caps, budget, models, flow, self-test switches), reads the prompt file, creates a Heartbeat and runs _loop; the final heartbeat is always emitted. Returns _loop's exit code, 4 when the prompt is missing.
items.doc_lint.say: Appends (level, check, detail) to the module RESULT list. Returns None.
items.doc_lint.read: Text of file p (utf-8, errors replaced); '' when it cannot be opened. Returns str.
items.doc_lint.rel: Path p relative to the project root, with forward slashes. Returns str.
items.doc_lint.check_frontmatter: L1: every active doc and archive/peer/*.md has frontmatter with type, status and date; records PASS, or a WARN with the missing / incomplete counts, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_citations: L2 / L2b / L2c: every project path cited in an active doc exists (FAIL when dangling; a plan doc's missing file is a WARN) and every cited :line is inside the file (WARN). Records via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_status_length: L3: WARN when STATUS.md has more than STATUS_MAX_LINES lines, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_one_current_plan: L4: FAIL when current_plans() finds more than one current plan, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_supersedes: L5: WARN when an active doc's 'supersedes:' names a doc still marked status: current, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_marked_decisions: L7: WARN listing active-doc lines that use a decision / measurement word without a DECIDED: / MEASURED: / DECISION: / ANSWERED: / FAILED: mark, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_decision_headers: L8: '## <slug> - <date>' headers of docs/violation-decisions.md (or path) without a parseable HH:MM: FAIL if dated >= L8_FAIL_FROM, WARN if older with an unparseable time; via say(). Returns (fails, warns) lists of file:line.
items.doc_lint.check_user_rules_lines: L9: WARN listing Pre-decided items numbered >= L9_FROM_ITEM without a 'USER-RULES:' line in the given paths (default all active docs), else PASS. Returns the list of 'path:line (item n)'.
items.doc_lint.is_frozen: True when the doc at p has frontmatter status: frozen. Returns bool.
items.doc_lint.run: Clears RESULT and runs every lint check in order, L1 to L12 (L6 replaced by a PASS note when skip_dispositions). Returns a copy of the (level, check, detail) list.
items.doc_lint.main: CLI: run() (--skip-dispositions; --quiet prints FAILs only), prints each result and a 'DOC-LINT PASS/FAIL: n fail, n warn, n pass' line. Returns 1 when any check FAILed, else 0.
items.elrule.unwired_inputs: {owner_uid: [terminal names]} of every non-source terminal in state['terminals'] that has no wire and is not a ControlTerminal. Returns a defaultdict(list).
items.errorlist_check.md5: MD5 hex digest of file p. Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.not_ready: True when the exception's repr carries a COM-not-ready marker ('-2147221231' or 'ClassFactory'). Returns bool.
items.errorlist_check.windows_named: [(hwnd, title)] of the LabVIEW process's top-level windows whose title contains sub, case-insensitive. Returns list.
items.errorlist_check.open_diagram: Makes sure '<scratch name> Block Diagram' is open: otherwise fronts the VI window and sends Ctrl+E (before/after shots and a confirm act in R['gui_acts_outer']), waiting up to 15 s. Returns True when the diagram window exists.
items.errorlist_check.make_on_item: Builds the per-item callback for lv_errorlist.read: double-clicks the Error List row, shoots the block diagram before/after and stores show_error (fronted, changed, screenshot) on the item; raises RuntimeError if the Error List closed. Returns the callback.
items.errorlist_check.norm: Lower-cases s and drops every character outside a-z0-9 (None gives ''). Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.ocr_fold: Applies the OCR aliases in order ('vl' -> 'vi', then 'v' -> 'y') to a normalised key. Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.norm_ocr: ocr_fold(norm(s)): the alias-folded normal form used for OCR-tolerant matching. Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.derive_expected: Error List licence rules from a stageplan's open_rows: per SubVI row a '<term> is not wired' rule, per other node one 'contains unwired or bad terminal' rule, plus one uncapped wire-class rule if any open row exists. Returns the rule list.
items.errorlist_check.main: CLI: copies the bed VI (--vi or STATUS's bed) to a scratch, opens it, reads its Error List (count-only or full with a double-click per item), compares with the expected file or plan licences, judges by final_verdict (a PREDICTED step-end expected file with its pred: stagekit.el_advisory decides, card 166-a1-3), deletes the scratch, writes errorlist_<bed>_<stamp>.json and a RESULT line. Returns 0 OK, 1 MISMATCH, 2 FAIL.
items.fn_records.rel: Path p relative to the project root with forward slashes; on a ValueError (another drive) p itself with forward slashes. Returns str.
items.fn_records.reg_path: Registry file of function fn: <reg_dir or tools/bench/fn_records>/<fn with ':' replaced by '_'>.json. Returns the path (str).
items.fn_records.load: The fnrec record of function fn read from its registry file, or None when the file does not exist. Returns dict or None.
items.fn_records.write_record: Writes rec (indent 1, UTF-8, trailing newline) to the registry file of rec['function'], creating the registry folder. Returns the path written.
items.fn_records.predicted: The 'predicted' block of a test plan from fncontract.TABLE: {postcondition: 'op value'} when the row has 'post', else a {'note': ...} saying no TABLE row / no postcondition. Returns dict.
items.fn_records.make_plan: Builds the fnrec/1 test-plan record of fn: source file/defs/line/md5 (locate), plan (card, scratch bed, inputs from PLAN_INPUTS or a default, predicted, outcome contract, pass_if), empty records, legacy scratch_verify evidence. Returns dict.
items.fn_records.routes_of_plan: Sorted set of route names (the part before ':') of a stageplan JSON's finalized.route_check rows; the actions' op kinds when it is not finalized; [] when unreadable. Returns list.
items.fn_records.load_config: The FN-gate config: JSON at path (default tools/bench/fn_records/gate_config.json), or a copy of DEFAULT_CONFIG when that file is absent. Returns dict.
items.fn_records.main: CLI: --write-config, --write-plans, --status [fn ...], --advise <unit> (launch_gate; returns 2 if refused), --add-record FN STATUS --log ... --card ...; prints what it did. Returns 0, or 2 on a refused --advise.
items.fncontract.outcome: Builds one standard outcome {outcome, fn, reason (300 chars), measured, expected}; raises ValueError when status is not in OUTCOMES. Returns dict.
items.fncontract.mark: Current sequence number of the call-outcome HISTORY (pass it to since()). Returns int.
items.fncontract.since: Outcomes recorded in HISTORY after sequence mark m, oldest first. Returns list of outcome dicts.
items.gate_fp.is_checker_gate: True when the gate name is a checker gate: 'guard_<x>' or 'checker:<stage_prerun|stagekit|stagesim|stop_record|protocol|launchunit|doc_lint>[:label]', case-insensitive. Returns bool.
items.gate_fp.read_queue: Every JSON row of the false-positive queue (path, default tools/bench/gate_fp_queue.jsonl or $GATE_FP_QUEUE); blank or unparsable lines skipped, [] when unreadable. Returns list of dicts.
items.gate_fp.main: CLI subcommands: log (log_fp), drain, note, close, list [--open], due; prints LOGGED / DEDUPED / DRAINED / NOTED / CLOSED / REFUSED or the list. Returns 0, 2 on a refusal or no command, 1 when 'due' finds the queue due.
items.gateclass.is_tunnel_class: True when cls is one of TUNNEL_OBJECT_CLASSES (LoopTunnel, Tunnel, SelectorTunnel, FlatSequence inner/outer) or any 'FlatSequence...Tunnel' name. Returns bool.
items.gateclass.is_semantic: True unless cls is in NON_SEMANTIC_CLASSES (Terminal, InnerTerminal, OuterTerminal, ParameterTerminal, Invoke, LooseEnds, TunnelFace): fail-closed. Returns bool.
items.gateclass.gate_kind: (kind, why) of a gate label: the first GATE_TABLE regex matching the label (name / census / rows / arith / fixture); ('stop', fail-closed note) when none matches. Returns tuple.
items.gscript.lv: The module's LabVIEW.Application COM object, dispatched on first use and cached; _check_poison runs first (raises COMPoisoned while an abandoned COM call is still outstanding). Returns the COM object.
items.gscript.op_hygiene_record_path: Path of an op VI's hygiene record: tools/bench/op_hygiene/<op file name without extension>.json. Returns str.
items.gscript.shutil_copy: Copies file src to dst (shutil.copyfile, data only) then sleeps 0.2 s. Returns None.
items.gscript.count: Number of objects of class cls on target's diagram, read by one OP_REPORT run ('# of Refs'); raises RuntimeError on an op error. Returns int.
items.gscript.uids: Set of uids of every object of class cls on target, from one report_all() op run. Returns set of int.
items.gscript.for_loop: Creates a For Loop on target at location via OP_FORLOOP with tunnels from the named controls, their indexing flags and the static parallel-instance count; ensure_loaded first, RuntimeError on an op error. Returns the op run time (_run).
items.gscript.exec_state: target's VI ExecState read through a short-lived counted vi_ref (0 = broken). Returns int.
items.gscript.main: CLI: 'report <vi> <class>' prints one line per object (index, class, uid, pos, owner); 'kernel <vi>' runs build_kernel; 'save <vi>' saves and prints the size. Returns 0, 2 on usage or an unknown command.
items.gscript.print_net_map: Prints net_map() output: per node '[n] style | label', then per terminal the other node.terminals on its wire, or UNWIRED / '(wire w, no other terminal in this diagram)'. Returns None.
items.hash_probe.probe: One 'HASH <path> | exists=1 | size=n | md5=.. | sha256=..' line for a file read in 1 MiB chunks; 'exists=0' with '-' fields when it is not a file. Returns str.
items.hash_probe.main: CLI: prints probe() for each path on argv. Returns 0, 2 (with a usage line) when no path is given.
items.jev.get_key: The TypeSafe API key from env TYPESAFE_API_KEY, else from the user Environment registry key (HKCU); None when neither has it. Returns str or None.
items.jev.normalise: Text with volatile parts masked: 32-hex md5 -> '<md5>', timestamps -> '<ts>', '#n' and numbers of 3+ digits -> '#', the project root path -> '<root>'. Returns str.
items.jev_candidates.node_labels_default: {uid: label} from tools/bench/main_vi_node_labels.json (every diagram's rows); {} when the file is absent. Returns dict.
items.jev_candidates.sink_state: State of a sink terminal row r in graph G: 'free' (wire_uid 0), 'half-wire' (wire in G['halfwire_nosrc']), else 'occupied'. Returns str.
items.jev_candidates.term_row: Candidate dict of terminal row key in G: key, uid, term, term_uid, term_class, owner_class, diagram, wire_uid, subvi; a tunnel owner also gets outer_wire (its OuterTerminal's wire uid). Returns dict.
items.jev_chain.reaches: True when node b is among the nodes reachable from node a (vigraph.reach4). Returns bool.
items.jev_chain.true_next: True when x is a direct subVI successor of y and x is z or reaches z. Returns bool.
items.jev_chain.subvi_line: One text line for subVI node u: '#u name; pane: label (direction), ...' (first 16 connector-pane rows from the wiki, or '(not in the wiki)') plus the wiki summary. Returns str.
items.jev_chain.ask_link: Asks Jev (ask_n, CHAIN_Q, purpose step5-chain) whether candidate x is the next link from y toward z, with subvi_line texts as state. Returns ask_n's (mean p, spread, err).
items.jev_chain.scope_counts: {subVI name: number of call nodes} over the subVI nodes in scope below diagram root. Returns dict.
items.jev_contradict.main: CLI: parses a plan's numbered items, builds token-sharing pairs (cap --pairs, max 600), asks Jev per pair (--samples), prints the top pairs and those at p >= --threshold, writes the readings JSON (--out). Returns 0.
items.jev_device_value.corpus: Failure corpus: retrospective VIOLATION lines (with loss_min/usd) and FINDINGS paragraphs from archive/peer, plus first failing lines of failed bench bgrun logs, jev-normalised and deduplicated, optional since date. Returns list of item dicts.
items.jev_device_value.classify: Asks Jev (default ask_n, 4 threads) for each item whether the device prevented / reduced / is unrelated to it. Returns the items with answer (winning class or 'unknown'), p and spread added.
items.jev_device_value.totals: Per-class counts, loss_min/loss_usd sums for prevented plus half of reduced (expected), the date span in days and expected loss minutes per day. Returns dict.
items.jev_device_value.main: CLI: --device text [--since/--after date, --slug, --dry, --reprint]: builds the corpus, classifies it (or reloads the saved JSON), prints one row per item and TOTALS, writes device_value_<slug>.json, compares with a prior run when --after. Returns 0.
items.jev_gaterow.main: CLI: '<bgrun log> [--run i] [--json out]': one Jev class per FAIL row of that run, printed as and appended to jev_gate.log as JEV-GATEROW lines; optional JSON of the verdicts. Returns 0, 2 on usage or no FAIL row.
items.jev_pairs.thresholds: The Jev menu thresholds from tools/bench/jev_menu_thresholds.json; when unreadable, defaults (pair/op/chain act 0.90, risk 0.10, none acting). Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.pair_state: The PAIR question state of candidate c: {intent, candidate (source -> sink text with sink state, scope, borders), src_wiki, dst_wiki (wiki_line)}. Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.ask_pair: Asks Jev (ask_n, PAIR_Q, purpose step5-pair) whether candidate c is the pair the intent line asks for. Returns (mean p, spread, err).
items.jev_pairs.op_question: The Jev 'choice' question over writer ops: fixed instructions plus criteria = OP_MENU descriptions of the given option names. Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.op_state: The OP question state of candidate c: {'row': 'SOURCE #uid ... -> SINK #uid ...; scope s'}. Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.ask_op: Asks Jev to choose the writer op for candidate c among op_options(c). Returns (best op or None, probabilities or None, options, err).
items.jev_pairs.ask_risk: Asks Jev (RISK_Q, purpose step5-risk) whether the change line with its code-computed evidence changes the original's computation. Returns (mean p, spread, err).
items.jev_pairs.write_record: Writes tools/bench/decision_<stage>.json: bed md5, intents, candidate pairs (row keys and facts), decisions, summed jev_calls, estimated cost and seconds since t0, thresholds, plus extra. Returns (path, record).
items.jev_preflight.main: CLI: '<file>': classify() it, prints each finding and one 'JEV-PREFLIGHT | <file> | class p=.. | finding ids' line (or '(no reading: err)'). Returns 0, 2 with a usage line when no argument is given.
items.jev_rowcheck.main: CLI: '[rows json] [--limit n]' (default SOURCES): check_row on each planned row against the terminal tables, prints 'JEV-ROW | i | verdict p=..' lines and an ok/suspect/unknown TOTAL line. Returns 0, 2 when the file is unreadable or has no rows list.
items.lint.self_test: Offline self-test: classify() on 8 canned paths and tabulate()/table_text()/load_shared() on canned ruff JSON; prints each failure. Returns (ok, fail) counts.
items.lint.main: CLI: --self-test runs self_test; otherwise runs ruff over tools/, prints the rule x class table, with --files <class> the per-file findings (--codes filters), and a RESULT line. Returns 0, 1 when the self-test fails.
items.stagekit.Stage.head: Prints a section header line '---------- <text>' (ASCII-safe, flushed). Returns None.
items.stagekit.Stage.gate: Records one gate: a failing label that gateclass.classify_gate rules LOG-only is printed SOFT, logged to gate_soft_log.jsonl and returns True; otherwise the label goes to passes / fails with a PASS / FAIL line, and a fatal fail raises Stop. Returns the bool ok.
items.stagekit.Stage.fact: Appends line to the stage's facts and prints it as '  FACT  <line>'. Returns the line.
items.stagekit.Stage.safe: Calls fn(); on any exception keeps it as _last_exc, records a FACT '<label> raised <Type>: <msg>' and returns (default, msg); on success returns (result, '').
items.stagekit.Stage.left_s: Seconds left before the stage's deadline: deadline_s minus the elapsed time since t0 minus reserve_s. Returns float.
items.stagekit.Stage.dump: Writes the stage record R (plus gates {pass, fail, failing, soft}, facts, rows, elapsed_s) as JSON to out_json. Returns None.
items.stagekit.Stage.summary: Prints the closing '=== GATES: n pass / m fail' line (failing labels, SOFT list), the JSON path and elapsed time, then the C6 RESULT line last. Returns 0 when no gate failed, else 1.
items.stagekit.Stage.file_facts: {path, exists[, md5, size, version_bytes]} of a file, with one FACT line (md5, size, LabVIEW version bytes, or 'IS NOT ON DISK'). Returns the dict.
items.stagekit.Stage.count: Number of objects of class cls on target (default the work copy), via gscript.count. Returns int.
items.stagekit.fixture_listing: Sorted base names of the *.vi files in the folder of gscript.MOVE_DST (the move-target fixture folder). Returns list of str.
items.vigraph.node_class: Class of the graph node a terminal row belongs to: 'ControlTerminal' for a front-panel terminal row, else the row's owner_class. Returns str.
items.vigraph.key_parts: Splits a terminal key 'node|class|name|ordinal' (name may contain '|') into (int node uid, class, name, int ordinal). Returns tuple.
items.vigraph.show: Readable form of a terminal key: '#<node> <class> <repr(name) or (unnamed)>' plus ' [<ordinal>]' when the ordinal is not 0. Returns str.
items.vigraph.wire_terminals: Sorted terminal keys of graph G whose row sits on wire wire_uid. Returns list.
items.stagesim.md5_file: MD5 hex digest of the file at path, read in 1 MiB chunks. Returns str.
items.stagesim.load_models: {op name: {path, md5, data}} for every *.json op model in model_dir (default OPMODEL_DIR); the name is the file's 'op' string, else its stem; an unreadable file gives {path, md5 None, data None, error}. Returns dict.
items.stagesim.base_state: Simulator state from a graph read: deduplicated terminals, objs, loops, fs pairs, owners (context files may replace loops / fs pairs / owners), empty sym; a previous simulated end state keeps its keys and negative-uid counter, a measured or carried Flat Sequence map is added. Returns dict.
items.stagesim.WriteGuard.unchanged: True when the current bytes of every snapshotted file and of every file in the snapshotted dirs equal the snapshot taken at construction. Returns bool.
items.stagesim.WriteGuard.restore: Puts the snapshot back: rewrites each file (deleting one that did not exist), removes files new in the dirs, rewrites the dirs' files. Returns unchanged() afterwards.
items.stagesim.new_uid: Decrements the state's negative-uid counter st['neg'] and returns it: the next simulator-made uid. Returns int.
items.stagesim.node_rows: Terminal rows of the state whose graph node (vigraph.node_of) is uid. Returns list.
items.stagesim.wire_rows: Terminal rows of the state on wire w; [] when w is 0 or None. Returns list.
items.stagesim.has_source: True when any terminal row on wire w is a source. Returns bool.
items.stagesim.obj_class: Class of uid: from the state's objs, else from the first terminal row of that node (vigraph.node_class), else None. Returns str or None.
items.stagesim.resolve_uid: Plan uid reference -> uid: an int as is, 'new:<alias>' from st['sym'] (SimError when no earlier action created it), else int(ref); an unconvertible ref raises SimError. Returns int.
items.stagesim.s1_partner: Maps a graph key to the S1 key (jev_candidates.map_key) and lists its S1 wire partners: direct sinks and effective consumers for a source, direct and effective sources for a sink. Returns {s1_key, how, direct, effective} (None and [] when unmapped).
items.stagesim.op_add_shift_reg: Simulates add_shift_reg: new Right/Left shift-register objects with inner faces on the body and outer faces on the parent, registered in st['loops'] (right_uids, left_of). Returns ({right, left symbolic keys, loop, body, parent, terms}, []).
items.stagesim.op_tunnel: Simulates a tunnel: on a CaseStructure delegates to _case_tunnel, else makes a LoopTunnel with its outer face on the parent and inner face on the body (dir 'in' = inner source) and its indexing flag. Returns ({tunnel key, loop, dir, indexing, outer, inner, body, parent}, []).
items.stagesim.op_delete_wire: Simulates delete_wire on wire_uid or the one wire at address 'at' (SimError on 0 or several, or an absent wire): unwires its rows and drops DROP_WHEN_UNWIRED tunnels left unwired. Returns ({wire, n_terminals, auto_removed_tunnels[, unmeasured_unwired_tunnels]}, []).
items.stagesim.op_delete_object: Simulates delete_object: removes uid (missing_ok gives already_absent, else SimError) with its shift-register partner, applies the only-sink rule to its wires, optionally flips orphaned tunnels. Returns ({deleted, class, terminals_removed, only_sink, allow_either, tunnel_flips}, []).
items.stagesim.op_wire: Simulates a wire src -> dst: a While '.cond' sink, Flat Sequence frame / border / exit routes, else same-diagram only; a sink on a sourced wire is a SimError, a sourceless stub is detached or joined; the wire is new, branched or re-created. Returns ({wire, how, src/dst term uids, ...}, []).
items.stagesim.op_remove_bad_wires: Simulates Remove Bad Wires: unwires every wire whose rows have no source, several sources or no sink; with drop_unconnected_fsit also drops FlatSequenceInnerTunnels left unwired. Returns ({removed_wires, dropped_fsit}, []).
items.stagesim.op_decide: Records an undecided choice among the action's options (no state change). Returns ({undecided: True, options}, [one candidate with intent, per-option pairs, undecided]).
items.stagesim.canon_diff: Multiset difference of two canon() Counters. Returns {only_sim, only_ref (sorted elements), n = total count of both}.
items.stagesim.cdiff_keys: Sorted set of the 'sink' values of a computation-diff record's rows. Returns list.
items.stagesim.load_s1: The S1 (original computation) graph of a plan: context s1_graph file built with vigraph.build4, else context s1_key via jev_candidates.load, else None. Returns graph dict or None.
items.stagesim.selftest: Offline self-test: runs the G-numbered gates on a synthetic graph in a temp dir, printing PASS / FAIL per gate, a GATES line and a RESULT line. Returns 0 when every gate passed, else 1.
items.stagesim.main: CLI: 'selftest', or 'simulate <plan> <graph> [--out-root, --plan-out, --naming-table, --collect-all]' printing a SUMMARY and a RESULT line. Returns 0 final, 1 not final or collect-all, 2 (doc printed) on usage.
items.stagexec.Meter.summary: Summary of the meter rows: n, first / peak private MB, last row, summed and mean MB deltas for 'op' and 'read' stamps, warned_at. Returns dict.
items.stagexec.md5: MD5 hex digest of file p (stagesim.md5_file). Returns str.
items.stagexec.dedupe: The terminal rows with repeated term_uids dropped, first wins (vigraph.dedupe_rows without its record). Returns list.
items.stagexec.is_ct: True when the terminal row is a front-panel ControlTerminal node (vigraph.node_class == 'ControlTerminal'). Returns bool.
items.stagexec.LVReader: Live reader over gscript on the work copy that Addr addresses through (diagrams, node_uids, node_terms, node_term_uids, ct_uids, obj_uids); SimReader is its offline analogue.
items.stagexec.LVReader.diagrams: Uids of every Diagram of the work copy (gscript.report_all 'Diagram'), in traverse order. Returns list of int.
items.stagexec.LVReader.node_uids: Uids of the nodes of diagram index didx, from gscript.node_labels. Returns list of int.
items.stagexec.LVReader.node_terms: The terminal list of node nidx on diagram didx as gscript.node_terms_uid returns it. Returns its result unchanged.
items.stagexec.LVReader.ct_uids: Set of uids of every ControlTerminal of the work copy (gscript.report_all). Returns set of int.
items.stagexec.LVReader.obj_uids: Uids of every object of class cls on the work copy (gscript.report_all), traverse order. Returns list of int.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.read: Live terminal read of the work copy via wiki_build.read_live (with the fs pairs); stores its secs and objs, returns the deduplicated terminal rows. Returns list.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.obj_classes: {uid: class} for the read rows, objects from the last live read first (classes_of). Returns dict.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.move_in: Stage.move_in of uid into the diagram index of dest at pos, then the junk purge; an op error raises ExecStop. Returns {err, s}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.add_sr: Stage.add_shift_reg on the WhileLoop loop (its traverse index) at y_position y, then the junk purge; an op error raises ExecStop. Returns {err, s}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.delete_wire: Stage.delete_wire of wire w, then the junk purge; an op error raises ExecStop. Returns {err, s}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.delete_object: Stage.delete_object of class cls #uid, then the junk purge; an op error raises ExecStop. Returns {err, s}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.rbw: Remove Bad Wires through Stage.broken_wire_count(allow_mutation=True). Returns {'rbw': its result}.
items.stagexec.SimReader: Offline analogue of LVReader over a SimBackend state: lists diagrams, nodes (owner-routed tunnel faces on their owner, loops on their parent), node terminals, ControlTerminals and objects as LabVIEW would.
items.stagexec.SimReader.diagrams: Sorted union of every terminal row's frame_diagram and the diagrams the plan made (st['diagrams'] keys). Returns list of int.
items.stagexec.SimReader.ct_uids: Set of term_uids of the state's ControlTerminal rows (the report_all 'ControlTerminal' analogue). Returns set.
items.stagexec.SimReader.obj_uids: Owner uids of the state's terminal rows whose owner_class is cls, first-seen order (the report_all analogue). Returns list of int.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.read: Deep copy of the private state's deduplicated terminal rows. Returns list.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.obj_classes: {uid: class} for the given rows, the private state's objs first (classes_of). Returns dict.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.delete_wire: Applies the op's plan actions with stagesim OPS on the private state (_apply: created ids renumbered positive). Returns {applied, check None}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.delete_object: Applies the op's plan actions with stagesim OPS on the private state (_apply: created ids renumbered positive). Returns {applied, check None}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.rbw: Applies the op's plan actions (remove_bad_wires) with stagesim OPS on the private state via _apply. Returns {applied, check None}.
items.stagexec.rel_root: Absolute path of p relative to the project root with forward slashes; the absolute path when on another drive. Returns str.
items.stagexec.read_adoptions: Every JSON row of the adoption log (path, default tools/bench/adopted_scratch.jsonl); unparsable lines skipped, [] when absent. Returns list of dicts.
items.stagexec.Addr.snap_loop: Stores the loop's current Terminals[] list ((name, is_source, wire) per entry, _loop_list) as its key snapshot, creating its slot {diag, keys, track} if absent. Returns None.
items.stagexec.Addr.track_new: After add_shift_reg on loop: difflib of the snapshot vs a fresh Terminals[] list; anything but insertions, or not exactly one inserted source + one sink, raises ExecStop; tracks r_outer / l_outer at those indexes. Returns {r_outer_idx, l_outer_idx}.
items.stagexec.Addr.retrack: Re-reads every tracked loop's Terminals[] list and remaps its tracked face indexes (identity when the count is unchanged, else a difflib match on (direction, wire)); an unmatched face becomes None. Returns the list of lost tracked terminals.
items.stagexec.Addr.triple: Live address of term_uid: exactly one row in `real` with the wanted is_source, else ExecStop; resolved by _triple and cached as (node uid, terminal index) when wired. Returns ((diagram idx, node idx, terminal idx), how).
items.stagexec.Executor.step: The simulated step n's JSON file (step_paths[n] from load_final_plan; 0 = base), loaded. Returns the step dict ('state', 'effect').
items.stagexec.Executor.sim_uid: A simulated uid: an int ref as is, else st['sym'][ref] (KeyError when the symbol is unknown). Returns int.
items.stagexec.Executor.obj_real: Plan object ref -> REAL uid: stagesim.resolve_uid on state st, then the 'obj' binding (a positive uid passes through); a still-negative uid raises ExecStop. Returns int.
items.stagexec.Executor.run: Runs the compiled ops: base / FROM-STEP read vs its simulated step, reader PARITY, PRIME address proofs, CHECKPOINT set; per op execute, read (whole or per owner), bind, retrack, compare to the simulated step (a diff stops unless record/soft). Returns the last real read.
items.stagexec.Executor.execute: One compiled op -> its backend call by kind (move_in, create, gate, stop, add_sr, wire_sr, tunnel, connect_term_uid, wire_remove_loose_ends, case_frame_wire, branch, connect, delete_wire, delete_object, remove_bad_wires), ends bound to real uids. Returns the backend's result.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.set_description: In-VI tag write via gscript.set_description(work, uid, text); raises ExecStop when gscript has no such verb yet or the op returns err. Returns the op record.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.get_description: In-VI tag read via gscript.get_description(work, uid); raises ExecStop when gscript has no such verb yet. Returns its 'text' (str or None).
items.stagexec.LVBackend.wire_sr: Wires a shift register face: register index of `right` in the WhileLoop's Shift Registers[] (ExecStop if absent), Addr.triple of term (source iff RightIn), Stage.wire_sr, junk purge; op error raises ExecStop. Returns {err, s, how, triple, reg}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.connect: Wires src -> dst by connect_route's kind: indicator, ctlsink/ctltun (wire_ctlsink), tunouter, ctl (wire_control), const_sr, const, cfw (connect_from_wire; loop_face_wire0 when the source has no wire) or nested (connect_nested_v1). Returns {err, s, how}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.indicator: Stage.wire_indicators from a WIRED source to a panel sink on the source's diagram (bare source: ExecStop); an op error is DEFERRED to the declared sink gate (sink_gate_for) instead of stopping. Returns {err, s, how[, deferred_to]}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.branch: Branches off tunnel tun's wired source face (outer, or inner when side='inner') to dst: a panel sink via indicator, else connect_from_wire (_cfw) on the face's wire; no wired face raises ExecStop. Returns {err, s, how}.
items.stagexec.LVBackend.index_mode_fix: Sets LoopTunnel #tun's IndexMode to 1 (indexing) or 0 with gscript.set_index_mode when it differs, re-reads it and raises ExecStop if it still differs. Returns the wanted mode (int).
items.stagexec.SimReader.node_uids: Offline Nodes[] of diagram index didx: uids of rows listed as nodes, owners of owner-routed tunnel faces, then loops whose parent is this diagram (or unplaceable), first-seen order. Returns list of int.
items.stagexec.SimReader.node_terms: Offline Terminals[] of node nidx on diagram didx: its own rows (no NOT_NODES class, no ControlTerminal), its routed tunnel outer faces and, for a loop, its registers' outer faces. Returns (node uid, [{i, name, is_source, wire, uid}]).
items.stagexec.SimBackend.move_in: Dry move_in: a destination diagram not in the reader's diagram list is recorded via _unroutable, else the op's plan actions are applied (_apply). Returns {applied, check}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.add_sr: Dry add_sr: applies the op's plan actions on the private state (_apply), no check. Returns {applied, check None}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.create: Dry create: checks the route's real-backend preconditions (verbs defined, diagram listed, per-route end / owner / label checks; failure -> _unroutable), then _apply and adds the uid(s) LVBackend would return (uid, body, selector, frames). Returns dict.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.stop: Dry stop: stop verb defined, loop in the loop table, source a Nodes[] node end (_node_end), else _unroutable; then _apply with that check. Returns {applied, check}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.value_gate: Dry value gate: gate verb defined and uid a BooleanConstant of the reader, else _unroutable; then _apply (no value offline). Returns {applied, check, value None}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.wire_sr: Dry wire_sr: the terminal's Addr triple and resolved name (_check, source iff RightIn) plus route / loop / right, else _unroutable; then _apply. Returns {applied, check}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.connect: Dry connect: the real backend's connect_route, the sink's address checked (_check) unless indicator (ctlsink: source triple), the loop_face_wire0 act added for a cfw from an unwired face; failure -> _unroutable; then _apply. Returns {applied, check}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.branch: Dry branch: tunnel tun needs exactly one wired source face (outer, or inner when side='inner') and an addressable sink (_check, skipped for a ControlTerminal), else _unroutable; then _apply. Returns {applied, check}.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.index_mode_fix: Dry IndexMode fix: nothing is read or set. Returns 1 when indexing, else 0.
items.stagexec.SimBackend.rle: Dry wire_remove_loose_ends: verb missing -> _unroutable; else _apply, then ExecStop unless the simulator's own wires for the row (last_effects 'wires') are non-empty and equal the executor's live wires. Returns {applied, check}.
items.stagexec.RetireGuardBE.delete_object: Re-reads the graph and runs retire_check on uid's pair (pairs[uid] or [uid]), records it as an LC gate; a FAIL raises ExecStop before anything is deleted, else the wrapped backend's delete_object. Returns its result.
items.stagexec.lv_run: LabVIEW run of a finalized plan: Stage on its base VI (pins, deadline max_min-3), scratch copy discarded, LVBackend + Executor.run, gates E1 (ops == steps), E2 (ExecState 1), E3 (end graph), E4 (optional reference VI); LabVIEW restarted after. Returns stagekit.run's rc.
items.stagexec.selftest: Offline self-test: builds a synthetic graph + plan in a temp dir, simulates it and runs the Executor / SimBackend gates T01.. and the from_step, create, c106c, c112, c127_4, c128 suites; prints gates, GATES summary, RESULT line. Returns 0 when none fails, else 1.
items.stagexec.main: CLI: selftest; adopt; dry <plan> [--from-step k --binding f] [--nonfinal] and prerun <plan> (RESULT line each); run <plan> [--reference vi md5] [--max-min n] (lv_run); else prints the module doc. Returns the exit code (2 = no command).
items.protocol.load_schema: The JSON schema of a '<name>/<version>' schema name (schema_path), read once and cached; raises ValueError when the file is missing. Returns dict.
items.protocol.load_card: Reads a JSON card file and validates it (validate_obj, goal-map ids when goal_ids is given); raises ValueError when not JSON or invalid. Returns the card dict.
items.protocol.make_result: A result-line/1 dict: status (given, else PASS when n_fail == 0 and no first_fail, else FAIL), gates {pass, fail}, first_fail cut to 200 chars, artefacts. Returns dict (result_line validates it).
items.protocol.all_result_lines: Every `RESULT {...}` line of text, parsed; a line that is not JSON or not a valid result-line/1 becomes a FAIL record naming it malformed. Returns list of dicts.
items.protocol.last_segment: The last bgrun run of a log text (segments(): one per BGRUN START). Returns (start epoch or None, start line, segment text); (None, '', text) when there is no BGRUN START.
items.protocol.is_legacy: True when the run's start time (else mtime) is before SWITCH_TS (2026-09-24 18:25, bgrun stopped scanning bodies); False when both are None. Returns bool.
items.protocol.path_in_globs: True when path matches a write glob: absolute globs against the absolute path, relative globs against the path relative to the project root (a path outside the root never matches a relative glob). Returns bool.
items.protocol.binding: The active.json record for agent_id (what bind() stored for that agent), None when unbound or the file is unreadable. Returns dict or None.
items.protocol.requires_path: Path of a card's requires record: <cards_dir or CARDS_DIR>/requires_<card_id>.json. Returns str.
items.protocol.write_review_card: Writes review card d to CARDS_DIR/review_<id>.json (UTF-8, indent 1), creating the folder. Returns the path.
items.protocol.verdict_contract: The VERDICT CONTRACT text appended to a review prompt: the answer's last line must be one single-line `VERDICT {verdict/1}` with this card's id and the role's allowed verdicts (ROLE_VERDICTS). Returns str.
items.protocol.open_decisions: Items of decisions_pending.json (path) whose status is 'open'; [] when the file is missing or invalid. Returns list.
items.protocol.write_steer: Writes a steer card to <cards_dir>/steer_<cycle>.json (UTF-8, indent 1), creating the folder. Returns the path.
items.protocol.main: CLI: bind, parse-verdict, render-review, validate, new, result-line, verdict, requires (their _cmd_* handlers) and release (write_release); no command prints help. Returns the exit code (2 = no command).
items.scope_header.read: Parses a file's scope header block (parse_bytes). Returns (header dict | None, error | None); error 'unreadable: ...' on OSError.
items.scope_header.canonical_sha256: SHA-256 hex of a file; a .py/.ps1 is hashed without its scope header block (canonical_bytes). Returns str.
items.scope_header.canonical_md5: MD5 hex of a file; a .py/.ps1 is hashed without its scope header block (canonical_bytes). Returns str.
items.scope_header.render: The header block text: '# ---', '# labview: x', '# hardware: y', optional '# offline-args: ...' and '# evidence: ...', '# ---', joined by nl with a final nl. Returns str.
items.scope_header.in_tools: True when path (quotes stripped, relative paths taken from the project root) lies under tools/. Returns bool.
items.scope_header.all_scripts: Every .py / .ps1 file under tools/ (skipping __pycache__ and .git), sorted absolute paths. Returns list.
items.scope_header.migrate: For each script (default: git-tracked tools scripts) with no header: appends the KNOWN or inferred block with canonical bytes unchanged (asserted), written (mtime kept) only when apply; NO_TOUCH skipped. Returns [(rel, status, scope or None)].
items.scope_header.main: CLI: check <file> (header, error, honesty, compile as JSON), infer <file>, launch <cmd>, rescope [--apply], migrate [--apply] [--summary] (counts + INVALID / motor / camera rows); -h prints usage. Returns the exit code.
items.jev_gate.with_next: The JEV line with ' | NEXT-ACTION: <action>' appended. Returns str.
items.jev_gate.ladder_cache_path: Path of jev_ladder_cache.jsonl in the same folder as GATE_LOG (a redirected GATE_LOG moves the cache too). Returns str.
items.jev_gate.ladder_cache_put: Appends rec as one JSON line to the ladder cache file; an OSError is ignored. Returns None.
items.run_mode.config: tools/bench/run_mode_config.json merged over DEFAULT_CONFIG (threshold_pct 50, stale_min 90, disabled False); the defaults alone when unreadable. Returns dict.
items.run_mode.effective: (mode, reason): 'performance' when the config is disabled; 'economy' when the mode file is unreadable or older than stale_min; else by weekly_pct <= threshold_pct. Returns tuple.
items.run_mode.write: Writes run_mode.json (mode from weekly_pct vs threshold_pct, atomic replace) and appends a RUN-MODE line to run_mode.log, noting a change. Returns (mode, previous mode or None).
items.stage_prerun.md5: MD5 hex digest of the whole file at path, read in binary (no scope-header stripping, unlike sha256). Returns str.
items.stage_prerun.rel: Path p made absolute, then relative to the project ROOT with forward slashes; on another drive (ValueError) the absolute path with forward slashes. Returns str.
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.G: Lazily builds, once, the jev_candidates graph of this file's terminals and objs (jev_candidates.from_parts, named by the file's basename) and caches it in _G. Returns that graph.
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.report_all: gscript.report_all stand-in: for 'Diagram' one {i, uid, class, pos [0,0], owner ''} per diagram (TopLevelDiagram first); for 'GObject' every obj, else the objs of that class, each copied with its index i. Returns list of dicts.
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.uids: Set of the int uids of the rows report_all(_t, cls) returns. Returns set.
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.count: Number of rows report_all(_t, cls) returns. Returns int.
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.node_labels: gscript.node_labels stand-in: one {uid, label ''} per node nodes_in(di) lists for diagram index di (labels are not in the graph JSON). Returns list of dicts.
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.node_terms_uid: gscript.node_terms_uid stand-in: the ni-th node of nodes_in(di) and its term_rows as {i, name, is_source, wire, has_wire, node_uid, uid}; (0, []) when ni is out of range. Returns (uid, rows).
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.read_terms: allterms.read_terms stand-in: copies of every terminal row of the graph JSON and a read time of 0.0. Returns (list of dicts, 0.0).
items.stage_prerun.OfflineGraph.read_live: wiki_build.read_live stand-in: {terminals, objs (copies), wires (allterms.join_wires over the Wire objs, [] if that raises), fs_tunnel_pairs (fs_pairs or []), secs all 0.0}; fs_uids is ignored. Returns dict.
items.stage_prerun.DryState: The dry run's mutable record (module instance D, reset by D.__init__() in main): taint counters, first mutating call, calls, graph with path and error, input md5/VI, Stage ops, addresses, Jev intents, unverified and fail labels, blocked side effects, works, executors, discards.
items.stage_prerun.dry_read_only: True when the recipe file exists and its VI-modifying stagekit calls (vi_modifying_calls) are non-empty and all in DRY_READONLY_VERBS (discard_work only); False on any exception. Returns bool.
items.stage_prerun.fake_com: Stub modules for pythoncom, win32com, win32com.client, win32com.client.dynamic, win32api, win32gui and win32con: every non-dunder attribute is a _stub; the submodules are linked as attributes. Returns {module name: module}.
items.stage_prerun.install: Dry-run setup: fake COM and gscript into sys.modules, tools, recipes and bench on sys.path, subprocess and os.system refused, writes/copies/moves/deletes outside %TEMP% sent to SINK or dropped (logged in D.blocked), Fake made JSON-serialisable, then patch_stagekit(). Returns None.
items.stage_prerun.patch_stagekit: Imports stagekit under the fakes and rebinds it for a dry: offline-graph read_terms/read_live, Jev decide/check stubs, logged candidates, K.mod wrapping non-PURE_MODS, dry Stage init/gate/_op/address/start/save/close/scratch/discard_work, counted reads, no-op restart, K.run. Returns None.
items.stage_prerun.stagesim_tun1: stagesim.TUN_FLIP as a tuple (the single-object tunnel classes LoopTunnel, Tunnel, SelectorTunnel). Returns tuple.
items.stage_prerun.plan_ops: Sorted distinct op names (as str) of the dict entries of plan['actions'] that carry an op. Returns list.
items.stage_prerun.lint: Scans the recipe's AST for int literals >= 100 that are uids in OG.cls, and non-docstring string literals equal to a terminal name (>= 2 chars) of one of those uids. Returns (sorted [(uid, line)], sorted [(name, line)]).
items.stage_prerun.load_memory_model: Loads memory_model.json (path or MEMORY_MODEL) and requires start_mb, read_mb, edit_mb, other_mb, final_read_mb and fail_above_mb each as {value: number, cite: non-empty}, else ValueError. Returns the dict.
items.stage_prerun.plan_md5s: {rel path: md5} of every plan file plan_files(recipe) finds; {} when that raises. Returns dict.
items.stage_prerun.write_record: Appends one JSON line to RECORDS (prerun_records.jsonl): t, iso, kind, script, sha256, plan_md5s, status, first_fail, plus extra; a 'dry' record gets dry_rule = DRY_RULE when absent. Returns the record dict.
items.stage_prerun.is_stageplan: True when path ends in .json and loads as JSON whose schema is 'stageplan/1'; False on any error. Returns bool.
items.stage_prerun.read_records: Every parseable JSON line of RECORDS (bad lines skipped; [] when the file cannot be opened). Returns list.
items.stage_prerun.stage_key: Lower-cased basename of the script with a '_v<digits>' suffix before .py removed (stage_x_v3.py -> stage_x.py): the key the retry cap counts by. Returns str.
items.stage_prerun.read_stage_runs: Every parseable JSON line of STAGE_RUNS (env STAGE_RUNS or tools/bench/stage_runs.jsonl; bad lines skipped, [] when unreadable). Returns list.
items.stage_prerun.record_stage_run: Appends one run record to STAGE_RUNS: t, iso, cycle ck, stage (stage_key), script, sha256, card id, cap RETRY_CAP, by (default 'bgrun') plus extra; cmd is not stored. Returns the record dict.
items.stage_prerun.scratch_skip_log: Writes line to stderr and appends it to SKIP_LOG (env SCRATCH_SKIP_LOG, default tools/bench/jev_gate.log); an OSError on the append is ignored. Returns None.
items.stage_prerun.main: CLI: --selftest-control-lint, --control-lint, --opmodel-conformance, --buildarray-check, --rebase, --check-launch or --scratch-required run that check; else --dry/--prerun of a recipe or a stageplan/1 (stagexec + X8/X11/X13/X16/X15), writes records, prints RESULT. Returns the exit code.
items.diag_replay_lib.new_label: Label of the last front-panel object of t (g.fp_labels order) whose indicator flag equals indicator and whose label is not in before; RuntimeError when none ('' in DRY). Returns str.
items.diag_replay_lib.pins: The pinned inputs as (name, path, md5): IMAQdx Get Image, the IMAQdx lvlib, get-buff copy and original, frames manifest (md5 read now), pane base and S1 (fixed md5 constants). Returns tuple of tuples.
items.diag_replay_lib.walk: Node table of diagram d of VI t: {uid: (index n, label, terminal rows)} from g.node_terms_uid for n = 0..79 until a 0 uid; a missing key raises KeyError, or gives (0, '', []) in DRY. Returns _Walk (a dict).
items.diag_replay_lib.term: First terminal row of rows with that name and is_source == source; None when absent (a copy of DUMMY in DRY). Returns dict or None.
items.diag_replay_lib.fidx: Index of uid among the uids of g.report_all(t, cls) (ValueError when absent; 0 in DRY). Returns int.
items.diag_replay_lib.diag_index: Index of diagram uid among g.report_all(t, 'Diagram') (ValueError when absent; 0 in DRY). Returns int.
items.diag_replay_lib.donor_class: 'Function' or 'Node': the first of those classes whose report_all on g.MOVE_SRC holds uid; None when neither; always 'Function' in DRY. Returns str or None.
items.diag_replay_lib.str_array_ctl: Makes a free String[] control on t: drops Get Controls.vi, creates a control on its 'Control Names' input, deletes that wire and the subVI, removes bad wires; fatal gate that the control has no wire. Returns the new control's label.
items.diag_replay_lib.pidx: Index of label among the front-panel labels of t (g.fp_labels order; ValueError when absent, 0 in DRY). Returns int.
items.diag_replay_lib.edges: Edge set of a live graph read: (source owner, source terminal name, sink owner, sink terminal name) for every source/sink pair on one wire, owners mapped through remap. Returns set of tuples.
items.diag_replay_lib.census: {subVI uid: path} over every diagram of t (g.subvis per diagram index). Returns dict.
items.diag_replay_lib.frame_paths: The N_FR (10044) replay frame paths f00000.tif, f00001.tif, ... under FR (G:\m8_replay_frames), in index order. Returns list of str.
items.lv_errorlist.lv_pid: PID of the first LabVIEW.exe in tasklist's CSV output, None when none runs (the visible-window PID set it also collects is not used). Returns int or None.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA: UI Automation client: CoInitialize, loads UIAutomationCore.dll through comtypes, creates CUIAutomation as IUIAutomation and keeps its RawViewWalker; its methods read or act on elements through UIA patterns.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.from_hwnd: UIA element of window handle hwnd (IUIAutomation.ElementFromHandle). Returns the element.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.focused: The element with keyboard focus (GetFocusedElement); None when that raises. Returns element or None.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.value: CurrentValue of el's Value pattern; None when the pattern is absent or the read raises. Returns str or None.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.text: Whole text of el's Text pattern (DocumentRange.GetText(-1)); None when the pattern is absent or the read raises. Returns str or None.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.legacy: el's LegacyIAccessible properties as {name, value, role, state, childid, defaultaction, description} (None for each failed read); None when the pattern is absent. Returns dict or None.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.selected: CurrentIsSelected of el's SelectionItem pattern; None when the pattern is absent or the read raises. Returns bool or None.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.select: Calls Select() on el's SelectionItem pattern. Returns True, or False when el has no such pattern.
items.lv_errorlist.UIA.set_focus: Calls el.SetFocus(). Returns True, or False when it raises.
items.lv_errorlist.send_keys: Sends key through gscript._lv_gui (action keys, WaitMs wait_ms, Exception Approved with the error-list EVIDENCE) and appends {act 'keys', key, tag, out} to acts. Returns lv_gui's output text.
items.lv_errorlist.main: CLI <vi> [out.json]: opens the VI's panel, reads its Error List with read(vi, out) (default out tools/bench/errorlist_<stem>_<date>.json), prints method, uia_items_exposed, n_reported, item_count; prints usage without arguments. Returns 0, or 2 without arguments.
items.guard_session.in_cycle: True when env CYCLE_SESSION is set and non-empty (a runner cycle session). Returns bool.
items.guard_session.session_id: data['session_id'], else env CLAUDE_SESSION_ID, else 'unknown', with characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] replaced by '_' and cut to 80. Returns str.
items.guard_session.state_path: Path of the session state file tools/bench/session_<sid>.json. Returns str.
items.guard_session.load: Session state from state_path(sid) with defaults dispatches 0 and retro_done False; {dispatches: 0, retro_done: False} when missing, unreadable or not a dict. Returns dict.
items.guard_session.save: Writes d as JSON to state_path(sid), creating tools/bench if needed; an OSError is ignored. Returns None.
items.guard_session.main: PreToolUse hook: BENCH_CELL or unreadable stdin -> 0; SendMessage in a cycle refused (2); counts SendMessage resumes (not to main), Agent calls of COUNTED types and Workflow; outside a cycle the chat context bound; then decide() under the session lock (busy -> 2). Returns the exit code.
items.guard_session.escalation_refusal: Refusal text when an escalation-rung dispatch (material-opus-max / material-fable-*) of a card with retry_of_card is routed 'scratch-verify' by stage_prerun.escalation_route; '' otherwise or when that reader raises. Returns str.
